correctness.rationale: The coordinate-box/Bowen-ball squeeze is uniform for all centers, via finite-coordinate uniform continuity. Independence gives the exact box product and coordinatewise attained maxima. A uniformly positive lower bound on maximal marginal concentrations yields divergence of deficits iff the product vanishes. Maximal interval concentration is weak-upper-semicontinuous, so the fixed-radius divergence class is a countable intersection of open sets; Lebesgue tails make it dense. Summable contamination of shrinking intervals yields full-support nonatomic non-expansive laws in any basic neighborhood. All quantifiers, infinite products, positive factors and boundaries were checked analytically.

value.rationale: The object is the natural class of arbitrary independent coordinate product measures of an infinite-dimensional dynamical shift. The if-and-only-if criterion is a complete infinite-family classification, and the Baire-generic/dense-exceptional distinction survives even with every marginal nonatomic and full-support; this distinguishes dynamical expansivity from local marginal support properties and addresses explicit measure-expansivity topology questions from recent 37B05 literature.
